features.name: Event Creation & Management
requirements: Create, edit, and publish event pages in under 10 minutes
Configure ticket types (free, paid, tiered) with capacity limits
Manage waitlists and set refund policies
Customize registration forms
Duplicate events
Export attendee lists

features.name: Ticketing & Delivery
requirements: Generate QR-based digital tickets
Email ticket delivery with 99% SLA
Mobile-friendly ticket access
Real-time check-in via QR scanning or manual entry
Track attendance in real-time

features.name: Payment Processing & Payouts
requirements: Stripe Connect integration for payment acceptance
Apply 3% platform fee on ticket value
Process weekly bank transfers (ACH/SEPA/local equivalents)
Hold payouts for 14 days post-event for chargeback windows
Enforce minimum payout threshold with rollover to next cycle
Withhold payouts if organizer has open disputes or fraud flags

features.name: Refund Processing & Dispute Resolution
requirements: Block refund requests after event check-in based on attendance records
Process refunds within 5-7 business days
Flag and block duplicate refund requests
Trigger manual review for refunds requested within 24 hours of event
Allow admin override of organizer decisions in dispute escalation
Log fraud patterns for risk scoring

features.name: Event Discovery & Search
requirements: Public event listings with featured events section
Search and filter by category, date, and location
Sort by date and popularity
Generate shareable event links
Support up to 10,000 attendees per event

features.name: Organizer Verification & Onboarding
requirements: Verify identity via government ID
Verify business registration documents
Validate payment methods
Perform risk scoring and approval workflow
Assign status: Pending, Approved, Suspended, or Rejected

features.name: Event Moderation & Content Policy
requirements: Automated flagging for prohibited categories and risk signals
Manual admin review within 24 hours of report
Notify organizers of removal with reason
Provide organizer appeal process with 5 business day response
Enforce escalating actions: warning, event removal, account suspension

features.name: Admin Monitoring & Compliance
requirements: Platform-wide event and revenue reporting with real-time dashboards

constraints: No mobile wallet support in V1
Non-critical features may degrade at 400-500 concurrent users
Payouts held for 14 days post-event for chargeback windows
